name: znetwork_dplay_dispatch_packet_to_handlers
description: zNetwork_DPlay::DispatchPacketToHandlers walks the registered packet handler list and invokes handlers whose packet type matches the incoming packet header.
known_limits: Current VC5SP3 byte comparison is not accepted for tier S: 0x48c200 has 65 unmasked mismatches after 4 relocation bytes and 1 trimmed VC5 NOP, with BN size 74 and VC5 size 64. Owner-sized byte acceptance remains blocked by sibling zNetwork dispatch-handler list rows.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48c200 validates a sentinel-list walk over g_zNetwork_DispatchHandlerListSentinel, packetType comparison against packet->packetType, and fastcall handler dispatch with senderPlayerId in ECX and packet in EDX.
The native zNetwork dispatch smoke verifies matching handlers are invoked, non-matching handlers are skipped, and the sender id plus packet pointer are forwarded.
